artworks.title: A Corner of the Artist's Room, Rue Terre Neuve, Meudon
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, and graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift (Partial and Promised) of Mimi and Sanford Feld
artworks.description: The image depicts a room with an angled ceiling, a partial window, and an adjacent wall taking up most of the space. The color palette consists of muted tones including beige, brown, and hints of soft yellow and white. The window is situated in the top left corner with sheer curtains hanging down and a small yellowish object placed on the windowsill. The wall with simple line details dominates the right side of the image, casting shadows and illustrating the room's corner.

artworks.title: Landscape with Cattle by a Cottage
artworks.medium: black and white chalk over softground etching on gray prepared laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift (Partial and Promised) of Mimi and Sanford Feld
artworks.description: The image displays a rural scene with a low horizon line in the middle of the composition. The viewpoint is eye level, giving an observer the impression of standing on a grassy hill. Cows are seen grazing or standing on the uneven ground close to us, while further back an old tree leans near a pitched-roof building, possibly a farmhouse. In the distance, a group of sketch-like trees extends diagonally upward on the left side, fading into the lightly shaded sky. The drawing is done in soft charcoal or pencil, featuring broad strokes that provide texture and contrast, creating depth and volume. The color scheme is monochrome, with shades of gray and black, along with white highlights that reflect light on the cows and building, resulting in a calm visual effect.

artworks.title: River Landscape with a Bridge and a Church
artworks.medium: black chalk with white gouache on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mimi and Sanford Feld
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch seen from above, showing a landscape with a stone bridge over a river, two figures on the bridge, a tower in the background, trees, sky with clouds and birds. The pencil strokes vary in texture for different elements. The sketch is in shades of grey to depict shadows and highlights.

artworks.title: Saint Vincent's Rocks and the Avon Gorge
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift (Partial and Promised) of Mimi and Sanford Feld
artworks.description: The image shows a serene body of water with a landscape in the distance. The horizon is low, allowing for a view of the sky blending into the landscape. Two sailing boats and a rowboat with a person in blue are on the water. On the right, there are tall cliffs depicted with textured brushstrokes. The color palette is soft with earthy tones and patches of blue. Figures are walking along the shoreline.

artworks.title: Three Women Seated by a Wooded Lake
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mimi and Sanford Feld
artworks.description: The image shows a view from eye level of a pastoral scene under tall trees. A body of water is visible through the trees in the distance. The tree trunks rise vertically, with expansive fronds and foliage above painted with broad, light strokes. A woman with a blue headscarf sits at the base of a tree, and a man in a green garment reclines beside her. The brushstrokes are soft and fluid, with a watercolor technique. The color palette is muted earthy browns, greens, and touches of blue, creating a tranquil atmosphere. Faintly visible figures suggest activity further into the grove.

artworks.title: Meadows with a Distant View of Oxford
artworks.medium: graphite and watercolor touched with white gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mimi and Sanford Feld
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral landscape from a low vantage point. The horizon is just below the center line, with distant architectural structures visible. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, typical of watercolor techniques. The color palette consists of muted earthy tones for the land and trees, and light blues and grays for the sky. Closest to us are grasses, bare earth, and leafless trees, leading to a field, lined trees, and distant buildings. The sky above shows soft clouds.

artworks.title: Boy on a Donkey Watching over a Group of Animals
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with livestock. The artwork depicts a tranquil rural setting featuring a group of farm animals, including a cow, goats, and sheep, resting under the shade of a large tree. In the right portion of the image, there is a donkey standing calmly. The background includes gently rolling hills and sparse trees, creating a serene countryside atmosphere. The animals are arranged in a naturalistic manner, conveying a feeling of contentment and ease in their environment.

artworks.title: Study of Heads: Three Goats, an Ox, and a Ram
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This image depicts goats and a cow. The goats have diverse horn shapes and are on the left, while the cow is on the right. The detailed drawing emphasizes the animals' fur and features. The background is neutral.

artworks.title: An Old Man Leaning on a Sack
artworks.artist: Giovanni De Pian after Francesco Londonio
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in red on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a pastoral scene featuring an assortment of objects and animals. The image depicts an outdoor setting, with a rocky outcrop under foliage in the background. In the foreground, there is a reclining figure dressed in draped clothing, resting against a sack. To one side, a donkey stands calmly, equipped with a covering or sack draped over its back. On the ground surrounding the reclining figure are various items such as baskets filled with produce, including vegetables, alongside objects that could be jugs or pots. Additionally, a goat is resting beside the figure. The painting utilizes a monochromatic palette with a warm, sepia tone. This is in the style of Rembrandt van Rijn, with detailed etching technique and use of chiaroscuro to convey depth and texture within the scene.

artworks.title: Quarry Pool
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Milton M. and Ingrid R. Rose
artworks.description: The image is a black and white print featuring a detailed view framed by large stone cliffs. Slender reeds are depicted against a rocky terrain, with rocky elements extending upwards. Horizontal lines suggest clouds or atmosphere. The artwork showcases careful lines and hatching techniques to capture textures and employs a monochromatic palette for emphasis on form and depth.

artworks.title: Masonry Versus Sky
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Milton M. and Ingrid R. Rose
artworks.description: The image shows a contrast between nature and man-made structures. The view is slightly from below, looking upwards towards a sky with large clouds. A stone wall extends diagonally from the lower right to the upper section, with scattered rocks in the foreground. The image is rendered in an engraving style with detailed line work, in a monochromatic color palette. The use of varying lines adds depth, especially in depicting clouds and stone textures, emphasizing an architectural versus nature theme.

artworks.title: Spillway
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Milton M. and Ingrid R. Rose
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with two massive curved embankments converging towards a narrow path leading into the distance. The horizon is slightly above the center, showing trees and distant clouds just above it. The technique appears to be a woodcut or engraving, with bold, linear strokes creating a rich texture. The embankments and sky are detailed with precise lines and cross-hatching for depth and shadow. The color palette is monochrome, with black and white creating a dramatic and graphic impact.

artworks.title: Untitled (Woodcutter)
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Milton M. and Ingrid R. Rose
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a person in a wooded area using a saw on a tree. The person is shown standing in the forest, sawing through a tree. The figure appears focused on the task, with detailed muscles visible. Surrounding them are snow-covered trees with intricate details such as heavy branches laden with snow. The scene shows a moment of physical exertion in a serene natural setting, with a play of light and shadow created by texture and patterns in the artwork.

artworks.title: A Pearl Diver
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person's upper body in a side profile view. The figure is seated and leaning forward with an elbow on a knee, supporting their chin with a hand. The facial features are partially depicted while facing away, with short, wavy hair. The person is minimally clothed with some drapery around the lower torso and legs. No jewelry or objects are shown, and the background is plain with light sketch marks.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.medium: red chalk with pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a head drawn in profile, showing only the features of the face and head without visible neck or shoulders. The person's head is tilted slightly upward, with the facial features delicately outlined, including a discernible nose, lips, and eye. The sketch suggests short, roughly sketched hair. The drawing conveys a bald or closely-shaven head, and the brow line is faintly suggested. There are no identifiable clothes or accessories apparent. The background is plain and possesses a textured appearance fitting with the overall aged and faded quality of the drawing. Written text is visible in both the top and bottom sections of the sketch.

artworks.title: Benjamin
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I after Crispen van den Broecke
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (cut within platemark): 21.8 x 15 cm (8 9/16 x 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a figure in classical robes standing barefoot on a grassy knoll, next to a large goat and a white kid. In the background, there is a rustic building with a thatched roof, and a smaller animal grazing nearby. The landscape features rolling hills, muted trees, and Latin text at the bottom. The style resembles that of a Renaissance artist.

artworks.title: Benjamin
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I after Crispen van den Broecke
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (cut within platemark): 21.8 x 14.5 cm (8 9/16 x 5 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a young man named Joseph, standing at a slight angle. He is holding a bow and potentially an arrow. Joseph has curly shoulder-length hair and distinct facial features. He wears a pale yellow tunic with a blue cloak over his shoulders, along with knee-high red-laced sandals. In the background, there is a stone building, a circular tower, and various small figures. The sky is lightly clouded and there is greenery around the man's feet.

artworks.title: Fantasy of an Antique Prison
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an elaborate architectural interior. It features intricate stone arches, staircases, and various architectural elements. A central staircase leads through a complex structure. A lantern hangs from the ceiling, and tools and equipment are visible. The artwork demonstrates detailed linear work and shading. Hatchings and cross-hatchings create light and shadow effects, adding depth. The composition seems carefully designed to guide the viewer's gaze through the scene.

artworks.title: Fantasy of an Antique Trophy to Augustus
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of elaborate architectural and sculptural elements. The artwork features detailed classical and fantastical architectural elements such as arches, columns, and a pyramid-like structure adorned with various ornamental motifs. The scene depicts the structure within a mythical space. Atop the pyramid, there is a globe surrounded by symbols and decorations. Intricate detailing in forms of reliefs, sculptures, and engravings is used to create a sense of grandeur and opulence. Various decorative objects like urns and shields suggest a thematic connection to power and triumph. The style appears to be influenced by ancient Roman architecture.

artworks.title: Fantasy of an Antique Tomb with Fragments of Architecture and Sculpture
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a large sculptural vase with ornate handles in the foreground, alongside architectural elements like a classical building with column and pediment details and a stone tablet with inscriptions. The color palette consists of shades of black and white. The large vase is to the right on a stone surface with scattered leaves. To the left, there is a detailed, rounded, and textured container, while above, the architectural structure with intricate column design and a partial view of a wheel occupies the upper section of the image.

artworks.title: A Meadow with Cattle at the Edge of a Wood
artworks.medium: etching with tonal etching and scratching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with tall, detailed trees dominating the foreground, a pasture with grazing cattle, a figure, and a subtly rendered sky in the distance. The monochromatic color palette features varying shades of gray.

artworks.title: Drunken Silenus
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows mythical creatures beneath a large tree. Various mythical beings and animals are present, including fauns, satyrs, and goats or deer. The setting is a forest with detailed trees in the background. Cross-hatching technique is used to create depth and texture. The composition portrays movement and interaction among the creatures, suggesting a narrative of celebration or gathering.

artworks.title: Drunken Silenus Supported by Two Fauns
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures surrounding a large tree. The scene shows several figures under the branches of a tree, with detailed features and flowing hair. The composition includes draped fabric and a jug. The shading technique and line work create depth and texture, reminiscent of classical European engravings. The monochrome drawing uses contrast between light and shadow to depict the figures and surroundings.

artworks.title: The Visit
artworks.medium: woodcut  printed in black on paper printed yellow
artworks.description: The image displays bold, black lines and angular shapes in an abstract composition. In the center is a figure resembling a ladder or staircase ascending to the top right corner. To the left, a figure sits in an ornate chair merging with the background, hinting at an interior room. Adjacent is an angular form suggesting a standing person with a static posture. The artwork forms an interconnected geometric scene resembling a domestic space.
